programme.desc: 本集講述了這些雄偉的座頭鯨的旅程,從覓食地到繁殖地,母鯨與幼鯨之間的溫柔時光,以及幼鯨在最初幾個月面臨的危險,包括與食肉鯨的驚人互動座頭鯨還面臨著一個充滿人類威脅的世界,從大型貨櫃船到尋找石油和天然氣時地震測試的影響,現在這些威脅再次威脅到它們的生存

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #2
programme.desc: 腔棘魚通常被稱為恐龍魚,在化石記錄中佔有獨特的地位,近一個世紀前重新發現它時震驚了科學界我們跟隨它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科學家進行探險,以揭開它們更多的秘密和行為

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #3
programme.desc: 在《兩條鯊魚的故事》中,我們將看看南非海岸發現的各種各樣的鯊魚,重點關注瀕臨滅絕的路氏雙髻鯊和標誌性的大白鯊

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 2 #3
programme.desc: 文拿在紐奧良與食物歷史學家璽拉爬瑪和食譜作家添麥菲帕鋼一起探索一系列迷人的路易斯安素食名產--素貝涅餅,秋葵濃湯,餅乾和窮鬼三明治作為餐前後酒,他在紐奧良這座大城市中心一邊品酒一邊上雞尾酒調製的一課

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 2 #4
programme.desc: 文拿與拉斯維加斯傳奇魔術師佩恩吉列特吃飯他探索賭場大道以外的罪惡之城素食現場,沉溺於素威靈頓牛扒,超多層的窩夫和精緻的點心,然後與食譜作家卡妮博妯共進晚餐

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 2 #5
programme.desc: 文拿沐浴在陽光和拉丁文化中,學習製作經典的古巴菜和傳統的波多黎各素磨豐果他與食譜作家華迪迪芙路基亞一起揚帆出海,帶著演員麥梅利到南海灘品嚐垂涎欲滴的心太軟蛋糕,又採摘和品嚐令人驚豔的異國水果

programme.title: 芭比的故事
programme.desc: 芭比娃娃在2024年慶祝65歲生日但她不僅是一塊12英寸長的塑膠或一個玩具 這位傳奇金髮美女已成為一種現象和小孩們的寵兒

programme.title: 珍娜·傑克森:誘惑的藝術
programme.desc: 珍妮積遜以其強烈的獨立性,有吸力的氣質和迷人的嗓音而聞名,她在MTV的成長成為她的催化劑;接受她的身份,並到達明星的巔峰

programme.title: 碧昂絲:鄉村音樂女王
programme.desc: 關注碧昂絲諾爾斯卡特的人生和事業,從她早年擔任組合天命真女主唱到現在的單飛生涯探討這位超級巨星多年來的音樂風格和靈感是如何演變的

programme.desc: 隨著日照越短,天氣越寒冷,加拿大的野生動物正與時間競賽,任何無法好好利用秋天作準備的動物都將滅亡

programme.title: 野外的一年:加拿大 #2
programme.desc: 加拿大的冬天既殘酷又美麗;動物們在冰天雪地裡掙扎求存;不過,雖然有些動物會靜候蓄力,另一些需要撫養孩子的動物則需要迅速適應環境

programme.title: 野外的一年:加拿大 #3
programme.desc: 今年有一個遲來的春天,但當它終於來到,尋覓配偶和組織家庭的競賽就正式開展;西部的黑熊和海狸,南部的樹蛙,東部的兩萬隻塘鵝,不分地域都想著同一件事

programme.title: 野外的一年:加拿大 #4
programme.desc: 夏季對大部分動物來說都是豐收的季節,但對北極熊卻相反在海洋再度結冰前,牠們無法捕獵海豹,導致日益飢餓對其他動物來說,夏天是幼崽們必須學習如何生存的時機

programme.title: 野外的一年:阿拉斯加 #1
programme.desc: 冬季的結束預示世上最大型又瘋狂的覓食潮來臨,大型海洋獵食者瞄準在阿拉斯加灣尋求庇護的數百萬條魚

programme.desc: Because of her love for cats, Claire carefully created a place called "There is a Cat at the Corner" While enjoying your meals and drinks, more than a dozen beautiful cats are strolling freely in the store, waiting to interact with you up close and enjoy a slow life with you However, if you want to pet the cat yourself and win their favor, you must first understand the nature and preferences of cats! programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Lucy the Staffie cross has been kept inside a dark house for so long that it's affected her eyes and she is extremely overweight She is taken into the RSPCA's care but will Lucy be able to shed some pounds and adapt to life in the great outdoors?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: World of the Wild E6

programme.title: Super Senses
programme.desc: There’s a whole world and more than one spectrum of sensations that animals are aware of, yet which just pass humans by And yet, while it’s widely known that, for example, a dog’s sense of smell is dozens of times more acute than humans’, or that goats have close on a 360 degree field of vision, there’s a kind of “sixth sense” that some animals have which still defies explanation Call it extra-sensory perception – animal abilities we can’t entirely explain but which leave us wondering - and in awe

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 主持們前赴「武術之鄉」佛山，自詡「標青」踏上梅花樁舞獅，表現「擒青」又「驚青」；中文學者廖舜禧亦細說賣藝開場白「夥記慢打鑼」的由來。客家麒麟與傳統醒獅大有分別，且聽麒麟高人道出箇中文化特色及背景，絕非紙紥下巴－ 口輕輕！「師父」蕭欣浩博士招親有命，智堅與文軒比武大耍「三腳貓功夫」，美恩師姐最終芳心誰屬？另外，「火水哥」為了追求「仙氣女神」鄺潔楹，誤墮天仙局任人宰割，卻領略不少跟麻將相關的中文知識。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 「風水佬」鄧智堅誤信謠言北上佛山尋寶，還被「拆穿西洋鏡」！要成為石灣龍窯工人，既要練得「鐵腳馬眼神仙肚」，還要學會雙腳「著草」？中文學者廖舜禧另會細說「吹」字開首俗語的出處，絕非「吹牛」兼「吹水」！單純男盲目順從女生要求，往往被諷為「觀音兵」，馮盈盈在「火水哥週記」客串娘娘，帶出哨兵、水兵等不同兵種的職責。智堅、許文軒上茶樓訪尋「揸巴士」美女，卻不知道飲茶加水要跟規矩，且聽鄭寶鴻趣談昔日飲茶文化。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 洛杉磯一輛餐車提供可「救地球」的食物是甚麼？進食台北某食店的招牌菜前，為何要勞煩一位男店員？王貽興及黎諾懿還要猜猜韓國某款熱賣甜品名稱，並在得到Do姐的提示後都答中了，貽興還替它改了一個更優雅的名字！

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 節目拜訪東京「咖喱科學家」，一嚐奇怪的咖喱飯配搭；參觀首爾的戲劇主題咖啡店，看看特別餐牌；見識秘魯人百年前釀粟米酒的駭人「精華」。吳若希被拍檔C君、鄭俊弘看扁必敗於衛志豪及陸浩明手上，她能否挽回面子？

programme.title: 科學一眼看清粵英
programme.desc: 《科學一眼看清》旨在讓每個人都能接觸到科學！透過簡單的實驗、有趣的軼事和壯觀的視覺效果，回到過去，了解最偉大科學家的生活，了解他們的發明如何改變我們的世界。

programme.title: 科學一眼看清粵英
programme.desc: 《科學一眼看清》旨在讓每個人都能接觸到科學！透過簡單的實驗、有趣的軼事和壯觀的視覺效果，回到過去，了解最偉大科學家的生活，了解他們的發明如何改變我們的世界。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 為參加星夢頻道樂園主辦的吉祥物認證測驗，閃亮CHU與玫露熊都很努力備試。相比游刃有餘的玫露熊，不擅長唸書的閃亮CHU卻顯得很吃力，在考試當日，她更緊張到連文字都看不懂。究竟閃亮CHU能否合格呢!?

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險粵普
programme.desc: 未來的小羊們獲得了灰太狼新制的發明“變小手錶”，變成迷你版小羊並坐上慢羊羊發明的玩具小車，前往微觀世界，幫助大家解決各式各樣的問題。

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險粵普
programme.desc: 未來的小羊們獲得了灰太狼新制的發明“變小手錶”，變成迷你版小羊並坐上慢羊羊發明的玩具小車，前往微觀世界，幫助大家解決各式各樣的問題。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 多啦A夢用「輸送箭」送東西去公司給爸爸，大雄看後靈機一觸，想到利用這箭去上學。爸爸媽媽翻看相簿，發現大雄去遠足時忘了把望遠鏡帶回來，多啦A夢拿出「進入照片觀測器」，進入照片尋找失物。

programme.title: 少女煮意日常粵日
programme.desc: 夏日炎炎，會室的冷氣機竟然故障。為了避暑，詩音等人來到外面，躺在地板吸收涼氣。就在這時，農業學會的櫻師姐來找詩音，還請她兌現昔日承諾，下田務農。如是者，大家就在酷熱天氣下收割蔬菜。

programme.title: 到此一遊粵
programme.desc: 古色古香的高雄蓮池潭，也有新潮玩意。自信十足的余思霆初次挑戰「纜繩滑水」，卻失手倒地兼傻笑？稍作調整，她終不負「滑水達人」之名，更成功完成跳台動作！哈瑪星園區保留了高雄第一個火車站的歷史面貌，思霆感受鐵道文化，再乘輕軌欣賞海港美景。深入柴山、穿過海蝕洞，發掘到甚麼隱密秘境？玩樂過後，思霆趕返郵輪歎世界。邊賞一望無際的大海，邊歎按摩，疲勞一掃而空！她還會大玩末日主題的VR遊戲，能否逃出「海上監獄」？

programme.title: 煮戰粵
programme.desc: 保哥隊的Stanley、Ricky隊的Anson分別擅長中、西菜，這次煮場交鋒，盼以「一雞三味」衝擊肥媽、幟哥、Jacky三大評判的味蕾！Stanley將雞三珍釀入「染紅」的南沙蓮藕；用雞肉、冬瓜粒巧製「白玉葡萄」，再以意大利飯煮法炮製糯米雞。Anson則奉上雞冠、雞腎配沙津；雞清湯搭滑燉蛋，西式焗雞腿卻拌入櫻花蝦、蝦醬，效果如何？兩人的創意料理內外兼備，看來哪一方能夠突出雞的主題，會是出線關鍵！

programme.title: 煮戰粵
programme.desc: 香辣料理不能一味靠辣，要將不同辣椒與香料融合，才可展現味道層次。嘉星奉保哥之命出戰，引領無辣不歡的嘉賓何雁詩暢遊「辣椒樂園」。炭燒擂椒皮蛋、泡椒蝦丸配油浸銀鱈魚、青花椒奶凍盡展功架，可惜最終超時完成，要被扣分！Steven採用至少四種辣椒調製「脆椒豚肉蝦球配香辣紅油炸薯片」，下廚過程卻略顯忙亂。焦急之下，他未有依循隊長Ricky的方法，單憑感覺即炸薯片，可會失手？綜觀雙方均有失分位，今場勝負難料！

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: 這道洋蔥鴨本來是Gigi姐一位好友的拿手小菜，適合用作宴客，而經過Gigi姐稍作修改之後，這次會為大家示範做法。洋蔥的分量增加了，而且會先略為爆炒才塞進鴨腹裡，用意為何？Gigi姐更會分享可以安全切洋蔥的小秘訣。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 有很多愛美之人都會因為食量超標而提升運動量。熱愛馬術及各類型戶外運動的傳嘉莉，早已養成經常運動的習慣，當然甚少顧慮食量超標問題。與此同時，嘉莉還喜歡品嚐各類型朱古力，藉此忘卻生活煩憂。有見及此，古嘉俊這次便創製了一款「柚子冧酒焦糖牛奶朱古力」，透過柚子的清新口味，配合冧酒的怡人芳香，為嘉莉送上日式浪漫情懷。多層朱古力餡料原來極講求時間與心思，到底一張皺摺的牛油紙如何反映阿古一絲不苟的「執著」個性？

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 看見阿茜受傷，良太表示會為阻止零時而戰，但太晴仍然猶豫不決。森戶來到大宮找太晴，並帶來了大家的口訊，太晴看完後表示明白到自己想保護的是什麼。零時再度來襲，伽馬、阿茜和良太率先應戰。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 相信大家都對兒歌<Twinkle Twinkle Little Star不感陌生，「My Little Show」有八位小朋友用弦樂合奏方式，為觀眾送上新鮮感。此外，七歲男生喜愛用鼓棍敲擊中國鼓時換來的刺激感，透過打鼓表演讓大家感受一下。城市發展少不免會有新舊交替，<囍帖街雖已面目全非，但可藉歌曲留下珍貴記憶。結他導師與主持們亦合唱另一首<燕尾蝶，訴說「摘去鮮花然後種出大廈」的城市變遷。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 改編自人氣繪本。各位小朋友快跟著無人不知的名偵探屁屁偵探全面出擊，透過細心觀察及推理，偵破各類案件吧！

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 爺爺收到朋友送來的雞泡魚，媽媽於是決定晚餐製作雞泡魚火鍋。小丸子在學校提及此事時，永澤卻說曾經有人因為吃雞泡魚而中毒致死。小丸子聽了之後很害怕，因此極力勸家人不要吃雞泡魚。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 近年有不少年輕人對卡式帶，黑膠等上一代聽音樂的方式產生興趣，並形成了一股消費熱潮。這數年來陸續有內地製藥公司來香港發展，對香港要成為生物科技融資及科研中心，有甚麼啟示？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 近年AI發展日新月異，已不限於功能性使用，甚至漸漸演化到為人類提供情緒價值，成為人類的 「伴侶」。AI 在情感支援上如何為人類帶來慰藉，AI 開發商又會如何設計相關產品？人類對AI的情感，又會否打破次元界限？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 觀眾遭收數團夥在門前走廊「淋錯紅油」，其後得悉被盜用地址，質疑相關銀行未有核實欠債人資料。坪洲九旬伯伯疑被經常派飯送湯的女鄰居，哄騙自住村屋的業權！負責處理伯伯生活支出的兩名親友，建議伯伯申請逆按揭，伯伯卻支吾以對，親友查察後驚悉物業已「轉名」女鄰居？新劇《模範律師團》在深圳正式開機，主要演員楊茜堯、張曦雯、滕麗名皆有亮相，並期待跟「好戲之人」羅嘉良合作。眾戰友為「中4」選手吳亦偉慶生，送上花絮。

programme.title: 保濟丸130 週年呈獻：中年好聲音4粵
programme.desc: 「安歌之夜」下半場，星級歌手許志安續任「嘉賓評審」，並負責揀選本輪比拼的MVP。開場時，安仔親自演唱其勵志新歌<信天翁，為一眾參賽者打氣。連同上集已置身「待定區」的周志康、許美琪、卓猷燕，本輪最低分的三位選手將面臨淘汰，最終有一人要離開「中4」舞台。此外，本集「知音人」嘉賓為音樂人吳國敬與著名時裝設計師馬偉明，跟觀眾一同見證舞台上的精彩時刻。

programme.title: 一周星星粵
programme.desc: 洪永城、黃翠如在鏡頭前常「相愛相殺」，卻會因接受老友鬼鬼的主持區永權訪問而收歛？回想眾人相識於娛樂主播年代，翠如、永城有何花名？逾十年前的舊片，已「神預言」翠如誕子，永城育有女兒？重看兩人合作拍劇情境，竟變成翠如「放閃」機會！翠如、永城的友誼，連網上潮文都有提及，究竟可曾出現某方追求另一方的場面？永城打算一句KO，沒料到翠如一個觀念才是重點！此外，洪太梁諾妍還拍片稱會與翠如一起大講不滿永城的地方！

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 陳國強師傅帶暉哥到新加坡組屋區的隱世海鮮餐廳，品嚐龍蝦大過小女孩伊麵、黃金醬香焗大蝦等佳餚，滋味無窮。倪嘉雯走訪土瓜灣一間烘焙店，試吃「人氣」炸蛋球沙翁、杜拜開心果朱古力脆脆麻糬及Ｑ餅，大感滿足！居港印尼人Spoon推介印尼「掃街」美食，帶伍倩彤細嚐炸香蕉糕、雞肉糯米卷等小吃，風味正宗。伍倩彤再隨美食KOL Arthur到全羊日式居酒屋，品嚐羊五花趾、羊肋骨等不同部位的羊肉料理，充滿驚喜。

programme.desc: 屠敏把日昇侵犯慕雪的證據交給以凡，以凡認為是Jackie搗鬼，命人對付他。世邦因屠敏與其脫離母子關係而暴怒，曉山為追捕世邦受傷入院。子峰懷疑屠敏身分，決定私下深入調查。風華歌廳常客洪伯伯猝逝，家晴黯然神傷。

programme.title: 東張西望粵

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: 這道洋蔥鴨本來是Gigi姐一位好友的拿手小菜，適合用作宴客，而經過Gigi姐稍作修改之後，這次會為大家示範做法。洋蔥的分量增加了，而且會先略為爆炒才塞進鴨腹裡，用意為何？Gigi姐更會分享可以安全切洋蔥的小秘訣。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 有很多愛美之人都會因為食量超標而提升運動量。熱愛馬術及各類型戶外運動的傳嘉莉，早已養成經常運動的習慣，當然甚少顧慮食量超標問題。與此同時，嘉莉還喜歡品嚐各類型朱古力，藉此忘卻生活煩憂。有見及此，古嘉俊這次便創製了一款「柚子冧酒焦糖牛奶朱古力」，透過柚子的清新口味，配合冧酒的怡人芳香，為嘉莉送上日式浪漫情懷。多層朱古力餡料原來極講求時間與心思，到底一張皺摺的牛油紙如何反映阿古一絲不苟的「執著」個性？

programme.title: 到此一遊粵
programme.desc: 古色古香的高雄蓮池潭，也有新潮玩意。自信十足的余思霆初次挑戰「纜繩滑水」，卻失手倒地兼傻笑？稍作調整，她終不負「滑水達人」之名，更成功完成跳台動作！哈瑪星園區保留了高雄第一個火車站的歷史面貌，思霆感受鐵道文化，再乘輕軌欣賞海港美景。深入柴山、穿過海蝕洞，發掘到甚麼隱密秘境？玩樂過後，思霆趕返郵輪歎世界。邊賞一望無際的大海，邊歎按摩，疲勞一掃而空！她還會大玩末日主題的VR遊戲，能否逃出「海上監獄」？

programme.title: 煮戰粵
programme.desc: 保哥隊的Stanley、Ricky隊的Anson分別擅長中、西菜，這次煮場交鋒，盼以「一雞三味」衝擊肥媽、幟哥、Jacky三大評判的味蕾！Stanley將雞三珍釀入「染紅」的南沙蓮藕；用雞肉、冬瓜粒巧製「白玉葡萄」，再以意大利飯煮法炮製糯米雞。Anson則奉上雞冠、雞腎配沙津；雞清湯搭滑燉蛋，西式焗雞腿卻拌入櫻花蝦、蝦醬，效果如何？兩人的創意料理內外兼備，看來哪一方能夠突出雞的主題，會是出線關鍵！

programme.title: 煮戰粵
programme.desc: 香辣料理不能一味靠辣，要將不同辣椒與香料融合，才可展現味道層次。嘉星奉保哥之命出戰，引領無辣不歡的嘉賓何雁詩暢遊「辣椒樂園」。炭燒擂椒皮蛋、泡椒蝦丸配油浸銀鱈魚、青花椒奶凍盡展功架，可惜最終超時完成，要被扣分！Steven採用至少四種辣椒調製「脆椒豚肉蝦球配香辣紅油炸薯片」，下廚過程卻略顯忙亂。焦急之下，他未有依循隊長Ricky的方法，單憑感覺即炸薯片，可會失手？綜觀雙方均有失分位，今場勝負難料！

programme.desc: 溢因協助打翻東西的少女收拾，被士多老闆誤會他所為，更施以老拳。眾人指責他不應理閒事，溢卻堅持自己原則。慶見溢霉運不絕，將「如來神功」秘笈傳給溢，但溢又被打收場，慶指傳功不過要他學習「隨機應變」。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 外科醫生指腎上腺瘤主要分為三類，高血壓是常見徵狀之一，如年輕人出現上述情況便應提高警覺。部份腫瘤需透過手術切除，醫生講解手術詳情，並提醒大眾日常注意多運動及控制飲食。有大學打破中式傳統禁忌，向學生推廣生死教育，希望讓同學以正向態度認識死亡，並珍惜當下。活動邀請鍾凱瑩獻唱主題曲<不散筵席；學者與凱瑩到臨，分享推動活動點滴，凱瑩還即席場唱出此曲。「睇餸食飯」，營養師陳國賓示範「蝦湯蜆肉冬瓜海參」。

programme.title: HOME即是識粵
programme.desc: 要打開沒有拉環的汽水，廚房紙、保鮮紙、膠紙、白紙，哪個是好幫手？Eric Kwok採取暴力方法，可有奇效？動作題對決，甚麼物品能提升山葵的辣度？在雪櫃找出答案後，同場加映眾人親試「加辣」效果，都吃得臉色大變。題目是問「香蕉、梨和蘋果，哪一種生果去皮後比較適合放入微波爐加熱？」，Eric竟搶答「橙」？此外，酸性、鹼性、中性，哪種清潔劑會令木地板變質？有醫生參賽者在搶答回合表現神勇，讓拍檔也大感驚訝！

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#1粵PG
programme.desc: 高哲召集俠盜集團成員商議盜劫大計；督察江揚正追查販毒案，發現富商趙君豪竟牽涉其中，而高哲等亦欲向他埋手。在兵賊追逐君豪時，差點撞倒包蓉蓉及其兒子波子，高哲出手相助。高哲在珠寶店發現蓉蓉丈扶英杰與上司搞婚外情，但同樣撞破的蓉蓉竟不察覺。蓉蓉幾經艱苦終讓高哲答應借出場地給她慶祝結婚周年。君豪在海上進行非法交易被江揚發現，將贓款掉落海，黃雀在後的高哲獲得八千萬元。蓉蓉與英杰慶祝紀念日，英杰竟要求離婚……

programme.title: Kiki & Nuna 知識寶庫粵普

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵

東張西望粵 及 香港大學：引領•無限粵
programme.desc: 沙田某公眾泳池日前遭雷擊，一個跳台損毀，幸無人受傷。事發在清晨泳池剛開放，目擊泳客大談驚險一幕。中環有大廈外牆搭建棚架兩年未見施工，不僅長期佔用行人路，近期暴雨棚架更出現斷裂及傾斜，引發安全危機。坪洲九旬伯伯向女鄰居「送樓」一事，伯伯稱是為換取對方照顧他終老，但有人收樓後疑未履行承諾。攝製隊安排伯伯聯同親友與女鄰居當面對質……最佳拍檔黃翠如、洪永城主持的《走過歷史大地》啟播，二人率先介紹精彩內容。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2829粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: 力王三兄弟在外地遭人扣押，敢威派力蓮救人。力蓮吃盡苦頭救回三人，獲敢威嘉許，並代表接龍出席盛事，以為可出盡風頭，卻事與願違。另一方面，樹根事事依賴尚善，卻偏袒若水，讓若水享有特權。尚善本要與若水、龔燁清理雜物，最終卻要獨力承擔……力蓮、尚善分別因故入院，均埋怨父親偏心，更稱如可選擇必不願當長女。二人其後相遇，意外相撞暈倒。尚善醒來後發現自己竟不再是長女，人生隨之改變，並嘗到身為妹妹的種種好處……

programme.title: 飛常日誌II#1粵
programme.desc: 香港國際機場因全球系統失靈陷入混亂，客運大樓及旅客體驗總經理楊尚偉、機場客運服務經理呂芷珊、機場保安高級經理陳杰、飛行區值班經理李勝祥，及見習行政人員程日飛、葉舒恩，全力處理這場不可抗力的事故。尚偉召開緊急會議，高雅雯竟以新任港灣航空駐機場主管身分現身，二人舊識重逢……港灣航空一架航班上，機長郭啟光與二副機師方可兒正執行飛行任務。高級艙務長張穎發現醉酒乘客因酒精中毒昏迷，情況危急，必須緊急降落……

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：走過歷史大地粵
programme.desc: 古埃及是古老文明發源地之一，堪稱建築奇蹟的金字塔，也曾傳出奴隸或外星人建造的說法。洪永城、黃翠如「穿越時空」，揭開胡夫金字塔於四千多年前興建的秘密。不同角度細賞金字塔，永城坐動力滑翔傘俯瞰奇觀，勁震撼；翠如則以雙腿走過大地，遊客式打卡！法老陪葬品除了金銀珠寶，還有貓木乃伊，古埃及人原來是貓奴？有指金字塔建築工人獲包食包住，工人村面貌「重現」！莎草紙工藝傳承至今，兩主持一探製作步驟，學寫古埃及文字。

programme.desc: 沈莞借秦莞的身分進入秦家，想要找出殺害爹娘和秦莞父母的真兇；秦莞偶爾在街上救了大長公主一命，更與安陽侯府郡主成為好友，獲邀出席岳稼迎娶宋國公之女的喜宴，但在迎親時發現新娘被砍頭，秦莞亦開始參與驗屍之事

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
無名天使3D#19粵PG
programme.desc: 麗花傷重昏迷，堅強斥責樂琦，樂琦百詞莫辯。寶兒發現槍手故意在麗花的避彈衣上開槍。樂琦得悉天華原是中情局的臥底，求他合作對付學文。堅強衣不解帶照顧麗花，麗花感動。政要鍾斯和香港議員關正良參觀電視城，樂琦負責保安工作，並派人調查發現正良已被學文收買。學文揭發天華身份，並劫持正良妻女，逼他暗殺鍾斯。樂琦及時捉拿正良，救出鍾斯，但學文劫持堅強和天華，在二人身上綁上計時炸彈，時神秘槍手出現，槍殺了學文。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 沙田某公眾泳池日前遭雷擊，一個跳台損毀，幸無人受傷。事發在清晨泳池剛開放，目擊泳客大談驚險一幕。中環有大廈外牆搭建棚架兩年未見施工，不僅長期佔用行人路，近期暴雨棚架更出現斷裂及傾斜，引發安全危機。坪洲九旬伯伯向女鄰居「送樓」一事，伯伯稱是為換取對方照顧他終老，但有人收樓後疑未履行承諾。攝製隊安排伯伯聯同親友與女鄰居當面對質……最佳拍檔黃翠如、洪永城主持的《走過歷史大地》啟播，二人率先介紹精彩內容。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 外科醫生指腎上腺瘤主要分為三類，高血壓是常見徵狀之一，如年輕人出現上述情況便應提高警覺。部份腫瘤需透過手術切除，醫生講解手術詳情，並提醒大眾日常注意多運動及控制飲食。有大學打破中式傳統禁忌，向學生推廣生死教育，希望讓同學以正向態度認識死亡，並珍惜當下。活動邀請鍾凱瑩獻唱主題曲<不散筵席；學者與凱瑩到臨，分享推動活動點滴，凱瑩還即席場唱出此曲。「睇餸食飯」，營養師陳國賓示範「蝦湯蜆肉冬瓜海參」。

programme.title: HOME即是識粵
programme.desc: 要打開沒有拉環的汽水，廚房紙、保鮮紙、膠紙、白紙，哪個是好幫手？Eric Kwok採取暴力方法，可有奇效？動作題對決，甚麼物品能提升山葵的辣度？在雪櫃找出答案後，同場加映眾人親試「加辣」效果，都吃得臉色大變。題目是問「香蕉、梨和蘋果，哪一種生果去皮後比較適合放入微波爐加熱？」，Eric竟搶答「橙」？此外，酸性、鹼性、中性，哪種清潔劑會令木地板變質？有醫生參賽者在搶答回合表現神勇，讓拍檔也大感驚訝！

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#1粵PG
programme.desc: 高哲召集俠盜集團成員商議盜劫大計；督察江揚正追查販毒案，發現富商趙君豪竟牽涉其中，而高哲等亦欲向他埋手。在兵賊追逐君豪時，差點撞倒包蓉蓉及其兒子波子，高哲出手相助。高哲在珠寶店發現蓉蓉丈扶英杰與上司搞婚外情，但同樣撞破的蓉蓉竟不察覺。蓉蓉幾經艱苦終讓高哲答應借出場地給她慶祝結婚周年。君豪在海上進行非法交易被江揚發現，將贓款掉落海，黃雀在後的高哲獲得八千萬元。蓉蓉與英杰慶祝紀念日，英杰竟要求離婚……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#119粵
programme.desc: 溢因協助打翻東西的少女收拾，被士多老闆誤會他所為，更施以老拳。眾人指責他不應理閒事，溢卻堅持自己原則。慶見溢霉運不絕，將「如來神功」秘笈傳給溢，但溢又被打收場，慶指傳功不過要他學習「隨機應變」。

programme.title: 夢華錄#25粵普
programme.desc: 盼兒與池蟠合作開辦永安樓，更以高價設下花月宴，邀請東京文人雅士赴會，他們對宴會讚不絕口，讓永安樓聲名大噪。千帆深夜造訪，想向盼兒解釋一切，盼兒卻不願見面。歐陽旭入宮向官家參奏皇后欺君瞞上，並以死相諫。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵

香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#120粵
programme.desc: 高家到中山旅行，但義、溢及情上錯旅遊巴，加入了單身人士活動，情成為最受男營友歡迎的女士，溢與義則爭奪女營友雪的芳心，差點反目。三人發現原來該團的目的是讓旅行社硬銷產品，結果三人同時受害。

programme.title: 夢華錄#26粵普
programme.desc: 皇帝為飲蘇合鬱金酒造訪永安樓，言談間發現盼兒與夜宴圖有關，盼兒意識到此人不一般，謹慎對答。盼兒找到千帆讓他配合她的說辭，但仍無法原諒他之前所為，千帆有苦難言。回家後盼兒竟在一堆紙張中發現一張銀票。

programme.title: 食平D粵
programme.desc: 「咖喱馬鈴薯」要做得好吃，原來有一個香料的黃金比例，而想煮出如瓜般爽脆的土豆絲，竟與一碗清水有密切關係。「大廚平煮」有陳惠文師傅以48元煮出鯧魚兩吃，一道菜中包含了炸和炒兩種風味。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 相較普通科，老人科醫生的角色從來不止是「醫病」，更關心病人的自理能力。「全面老年評估」除檢視身體狀況外，連認知、情緒、生活能力均會評估。病人如患長期病，老人科醫生又會如何在治療風險、生活質素上做平衡？粵劇界甚有成就的蔣文端被列為國家一級演員，近年她參與新式的「小劇場粵劇」，實際表演形式是怎樣的？原來端姐曾於TVB實習兩年，當時的拍劇經驗對其有何得着和啟發？「睇餸食飯」，三姐奉上「腐乳茄子燜鯇魚」。

programme.title: HOME即是識粵
programme.desc: 蘇麗珊、羅雪妍；許靖韻、艾妮，與四組素人精英齊集決賽，力爭識HOME王座。問到有助解凍雪藏肉的金屬，麗珊自信解題，令森美大跌眼鏡！螺絲題似是素人工程師的搶分領域，惟實情不似預期。女醫生藉親身經歷解答如何清洗血漬；有人亦以科普經驗答電視題，換來不同結果！關於不鏽鋼用具神秘數字，靖韻獲「辣手摧花」隊畀貼士，有伏嗎？黃氏伉儷的互動繼續有火花，黃生錯有錯着答中開箱題振夫綱，黃太背熟指定垃圾袋價目表還擊……

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#2粵PG
programme.desc: 蓉蓉欲爭兒子撫養權，英杰反指她濫藥，蓉蓉方知英杰一直要她食的「維他命丸」是精神科藥物。高哲好友范國軒是賭船股東，協助高哲洗黑錢，高哲在賭船的閉路電視看見君豪。江揚妻子康美莉誤會丈夫升職，竟購下赤柱豪宅。江揚調往重案組，和下屬鄭尚武發現師傅劉宇超殉職案新線索。蓉蓉決定不要英杰的贍養費，餐廳經理Pinky建議她暫住餐廳閣樓。江揚誘使目標疑犯譚彬唸急口令，以套取聲紋將他入罪。高哲得悉命令明翔「射殺」他。

programme.title: Kiki & Nuna 知識寶庫粵普
programme.desc: 在小鎮上生活著六個小朋友，在他們的日常生活中，會遇到形形色色的問題，有朋友之間的情感問題，有生活中的安全問題，有待人處事的行為規範，美妙世界的科學原理

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 四位小朋友來到零食廠，薯片隊兩姊弟初時似乎未弄清「廠長話」的遊戲規則，都曾在熱身階段失手。進入正式比賽，家姐還做出小動作，緊張地提示弟弟不要亂動！果園收集水果關卡，可能因為曲奇隊有高度優勢，不足一分鐘就完成任務。薯片隊的家姐向弟弟發出窩心提示，讓弟弟沒有摘錯指定水果。至於運送雪糕球走過「溶化之橋」的任務，芭菲精靈堆疊雪糕的考驗，似乎比起小兵運送過程更大？有小兵還要求運送心水口味的雪糕球呢！

programme.title: 天才高球少女粵日
programme.desc: 蜻蛉以平標準桿成績完成賽事，艾瑪與圓先後以低一桿成績完賽，無緣爭勝，檜本來打出平標準桿，但她在眾人面前承認作弊，失去比賽資格，令蜻蛉自動成為冠軍，意想不到的結果令五十嵐大喜。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: ADHD（注意缺陷與多動障礙）是一種神經發育疾病，本質是大腦多巴胺等神經傳導物質失調，導致執行功能受損。精神科疾病的診斷大多是靠評估量表，很少有客觀測試。最近香港科技大學就引進了評估ADHD的設備，可以進行三種客觀測試，測量ADHD程度。ADHD的治療包括藥物和其他心理治療方法等，因為治療ADHD的藥物是毒品的一種，這種客觀化測試也能讓醫生更謹慎開藥。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 香港大學：引領•無限粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2830粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: 力蓮醒來後發現自己成了力王的妹妹，人生截然不同，備受敢威疼愛。力蓮與尚善相遇，知悉對方同樣擺脫長女束縛，雙雙決定留在這個時空享受「做細」的幸福。其後，力蓮發現力王面對困難，為解決接龍財困竟決意犧牲，力蓮要阻止卻不果。另一方面，尚善發現樹根身體不適，他卻事事依賴若水，執意待若水回來再決定可要就醫……最終，力蓮、尚善在醫院相遇，均感受到「做細」的無力感下，遂對這個時空不滿，並嘗試返回原來的世界……

programme.title: 飛常日誌II#2粵
programme.desc: 尚偉臨危不亂，緊急協調跑道優先權，成功協助醫療緊急航班安全降落。系統恢復，機場回復正常，尚偉在記者會上強調「人，才是科技故障中最可靠的防線」。前人氣男團成員車成軒新入職任機場保安，卻引粉絲圍堵，陳杰苦惱如何安頓成軒……航班因機件故障需要延遲，機場滯留旅客情緒沸騰，張穎耐心疏導。啟光憑藉豐富經驗，精準判斷飛機維修時限，與雅雯在決策上交鋒……尚偉的徒弟日飛參與「經珠港飛」統籌項目時，銀川突發沙塵暴……

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：走過歷史大地粵PG
programme.desc: 獅身人面像是埃及歷史名勝，但有傳是拿破崙下令炮轟導致其鼻子殘缺？兩主持又再化身「AI時空旅人」拜訪這位法蘭西將領。「爛鼻」兇手或是十四世紀的蘇菲派信徒，永城還偶然「參與」了這段歷史。二人參觀博物館目睹法老圖坦卡門曾祖父母的木乃伊後，再透過AI「回到過去」，一探製作木乃伊的防腐儀式。主持們還走進餐廳，試吃一款用米飯、扁豆、鷹嘴豆等製作的埃及國民美食；再置身傳統的哈利利市集，並為拍檔挑選民族服飾穿搭。

programme.title: 女法醫解密#2粵普PG
programme.desc: 秦莞在屍體上發現齒痕，懷疑宋柔出嫁前可能與人有私情，便想剖屍查驗，但魏言之顯然不情願，讓秦莞懷疑起他…魏言之的隨從承認魏綦之就是宋柔的情人，但秦莞後來在屍體胃裡找到紙屑，而紙屑的原料能證魏綦之的清白…

無名天使3D#20粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)天華為救堅強，盡力割開堅強身上的炸彈，自己未能及時拆彈，唯有跳海求生，僥倖不死。麗花和樂琦在街上碰上堅強，堅強落荒而逃，二女逼他要作出決定。一鳴突然向寶兒提出分手，坦言有感於寶兒從來也不關心他，寶兒自覺有不是之處，接受分手。麗花和樂琦決定放開懷抱，一同尋歡作樂，寶兒私下約了堅強跟二人見面，玩緣份遊戲，以翌日大廈的燈光顏色作堅強選擇的根據。三人在大廈一帶徘徊，腦中所想是彼此快樂的回憶……

programme.desc: 蘇麗珊、羅雪妍；許靖韻、艾妮，與四組素人精英齊集決賽，力爭識HOME王座。問到有助解凍雪藏肉的金屬，麗珊自信解題，令森美大跌眼鏡！螺絲題似是素人工程師的搶分領域，惟實情不似預期。女醫生藉親身經歷解答如何清洗血漬；有人亦以科普經驗答電視題，換來不同結果！關於不鏽鋼用具神秘數字，靖韻獲「辣手摧花」隊畀貼士，有伏嗎？黃氏伉儷的互動繼續有火花，黃生錯有錯着答中開箱題振夫綱，黃太背熟指定垃圾袋價目表還擊……

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#2粵PG
programme.desc: 蓉蓉欲爭兒子撫養權，英杰反指她濫藥，蓉蓉方知英杰一直要她食的「維他命丸」是精神科藥物。高哲好友范國軒是賭船股東，協助高哲洗黑錢，高哲在賭船的閉路電視看見君豪。江揚妻子康美莉誤會丈夫升職，竟購下赤柱豪宅。江揚調往重案組，和下屬鄭尚武發現師傅劉宇超殉職案新線索。蓉蓉決定不要英杰的贍養費，餐廳經理Pinky建議她暫住餐廳閣樓。江揚誘使目標疑犯譚彬唸急口令，以套取聲紋將他入罪。高哲得悉命令明翔「射殺」他。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#120粵
programme.desc: 高家到中山旅行，但義、溢及情上錯旅遊巴，加入了單身人士活動，情成為最受男營友歡迎的女士，溢與義則爭奪女營友雪的芳心，差點反目。三人發現原來該團的目的是讓旅行社硬銷產品，結果三人同時受害。

programme.title: 夢華錄#26粵普
programme.desc: 皇帝為飲蘇合鬱金酒造訪永安樓，言談間發現盼兒與夜宴圖有關，盼兒意識到此人不一般，謹慎對答。盼兒找到千帆讓他配合她的說辭，但仍無法原諒他之前所為，千帆有苦難言。回家後盼兒竟在一堆紙張中發現一張銀票。

programme.title: 我係小廚神3粵
programme.desc: 主持帶小廚神8強到上海街，認識秤、砧板、刀的不同款式和用途，還向李家鼎請教刀功，即席切出條條粗幼相同的馬鈴薯絲，他們切條的大意舉動卻讓鼎爺看得心驚膽跳！今集比賽以水果為題，有小朋友的自信之作慘遭劣評，亦有一道香蕉牛肉卷，令星級評判泰臣體驗到「舞台幻象」。鼎爺毫不客氣為他們提供改善建議，有人聽後雙眼發光，證明其廚藝了得！一道令鼎爺又愛又恨的菜式，能否奪得小廚神星章？專業評判又怎樣評價各人？

programme.title: 小木偶皮諾丘與朋友們
programme.desc: 固執的小木偶皮諾丘，還有他的朋友－－海盜布偶芙莉達和小蟋蟀吉米尼，隨時都準備好出發去冒險！只要有朋友一起，任何地方都不算遠，任何挑戰都難不倒他們！

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 幽靈醫生
programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 幽靈醫生
programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: You Cant Win Em All
programme.desc: As the Ottoman Empire collapses throughout Turkey in 1922, a number of adventurers from all over the world sign on to protect the locals from thieves and marauders--for a hefty price. Two such mercenaries are Adam and Josh, who are hired by provincial Turkish governor Osman. Adam and Josh are expected to protect their boss' gold shipment, and to provide safe conduct for Osman Bey's three daughters. Along the way, our 'heroes' decide to forget their mission and abscond with the gold, but their plans are foiled by their own inherent ineptitude--and by the bothersome interference of duplicitous Colonel Elci.

Allí, los átomos de sodio y cloro viven un largo conflicto. El cloro quiere unirse al sodio para formar moléculas de cloruro de sodio, mientras que los átomos de sodio prefieren permanecer juntos. La patrulla de antimateria entra en contacto con el cloro y les propone proporcionarles rifles para dominar al sodio y así obligarlos a molecularizarse, pero Chip se burla de la antimateria y logra que el cloro y el sodio dejen de ser enemigos, restableciendo la paz en el mundo submarino.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La tormenta

Pero cuando el viento amaina, Chip idea una estrategia y deja a la antimateria encerrada en el molino, mientras él y los átomos siguen adelante.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La trampa de la armonica
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: Our River...Our Sky
programme.desc: Baghdad. Sara, a single mother and novelist, shocked into silence by the surrounding violence, has been unable to write. She and her neighbours struggle to resist the fragmentation of their world and renew a fragile sense of hope for a better future.

programme.title: Remember To Blink
programme.desc: Jacqueline adopts two children from a foreign country with her husband. To help with translation, the kids are accompanied by Gabriele, a twenty-year old who is just starting to taste the sweetness of feeling power.

programme.title: Metal Heart
programme.desc: Fraternal twin sisters Emma and Chantal are worlds apart. When their parents go away for the summer, their simmering sibling rivalry threatens to boil over, especially when the mysterious boy next door moves back in.

programme.title: East Frisian: Moor
programme.desc: Frank Weller's perfect proposal plans are derailed as he and Inspector Ann Kathrin Klaasen delve into a gruesome case. The couple must solve a case involving a poorly concealed body in Uplengen Moor and a kidnapping of twins in the city center.

programme.title: Coureur
programme.desc: Felix grows up exposed to the hedonistic lifestyle of his father’s veteran cycling races – alcohol and drugs. As a teenager, he is determined to become a pro and supersede his father. However, the cruel competition and his weak health threaten his dreams.

programme.title: Latin For All
programme.desc: Delphine, a disillusioned Latin teacher, made a deal with her class of 5 lazy students: if they keep quiet, they’ll all receive A grades without having to learn anything. Unfortunately, this qualifies them for a Latin competition taking place in Naples.

programme.title: Sleepless Night
programme.desc: A cop with a connection to the criminal underworld finds his secret life exposed when he and his partner are caught stealing cocaine from a powerful drug dealer, a move that puts his son's life in jeopardy.

programme.title: Milk Teeth
programme.desc: Living in a small rural community, Skalde navigates societal stigma due to having an “outsider” mother. When she befriends a mysterious girl in the woods, Skalde jeopardizes everything, struggling to balance loyalty to her community and her newfound bond.

programme.title: Detour
programme.desc: Law student Harper suspects his stepdad of causing the accident that sent his mother into a coma. After drowning his sorrows at a seedy bar one night, he wakes up to the realization that he may have hired a hitman and his girlfriend to kill his stepdad.

programme.title: Murders on the Frioul Islands
programme.desc: When a renowned editor is found dead on stage during a play, young Captain Victor Mariani is put in charge of the case. But tensions rise and secrets surface when his father Pierre, a retired commissioner and old friend of the victim, joins the case.

programme.title: Codename Holec
programme.desc: Honza films the Russian invasion of 1968 in Prague and takes the politically charged movie and actress Eva, the love of his life, on a secret trip to Vienna. There they meet a director who knows Eva very well and the Czech Secret Service even better.

programme.title: Bad Investigate

programme.title: Ricky

programme.title: On The Fringe

programme.title: Red Eagle

programme.title: Nadiya's Party Feasts S01 - EP1

programme.desc: Mum and Dad are going on an adventure wearing the kids as their cheeky backpacks! Seeing the sights and buying street food, backpacking is a blast - until they lose their passports.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - The Adventure
programme.desc: Princesses, horses and magic wands. Bluey and Chloe can play any role they want, when they embark on an adventure to save their playground kingdom from the Greedy Queen.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Copycat
programme.desc: Bluey's having fun copying everything Dad says and does, but the game takes a serious turn when Bluey finds a hurt budgie and they have to make an emergency trip to the vet.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - The Sleepover
programme.desc: A sleepover with their cousin means Bluey and Bingo get to stay up late! But when Muffin shows up exhausted after missing her nap, the girls get more fun than they bargained for.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Manatees
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head off on a global adventure to crystal river in Florida, North America, to find out how manatees survive the cold water in winter.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Grey Headed Albatross
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to Bird Island in Antarctica to help rescue a grey-headed albatross chick that gets blown off its nest during a storm.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Not Enough Room
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are about to go on the Tubby Custard Ride with the hat, bag, ball and scooter when they realise there is not enough room. The Noo-­Noo looks after their things.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S05 - Snow
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say `snow', and goes on a whirlwind word adventure. They see lots of snow, cold snow, falling snow, twinkly snow and yummy snow. There's sparkly snow and sledging snow, and Dee and Penguin have fun throwing snow.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S03 - Wobbly Tower
programme.desc: When Mayor Oki wants to build a new tower, Messy is keen to help. There is just one problem - all his towers fall over...

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - The Swoppiton Duck
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo need Ted's help to pull a wobbly duck statue up Swoppiton Hill. But does Ted know the best way? And will there be anything left of the duck when they get there?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - The Decider
programme.desc: The Heelers and Lucky's family get together to watch the big game, a fun family experiences that gets a little tense.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dirt
programme.desc: Judo desperately wants to play in the dirt with Bluey and Bingo, but she is not supposed to get herself dirty.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Cheerleading Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find Duggee's cheerleader pompoms, so he shows them his old moves. Time to practice: Duggee at the chess board, the Squirrels as a squad. There's a big match ahead...

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: It's a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mysterious Milkshake
programme.desc: More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Animals
programme.desc: The Squirrel club play games involving animals. The chickens do some rhythmic office work.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Leaning Tower of Pisa, Italy
programme.desc: The Go Jetters race to fix the Leaning Tower of Pisa, but has it really been glitched?

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Work
programme.desc: In a game of 'Work', Dad hires Bluey and Bingo at his drainpipe factory. But when Bluey takes charge, Dad finds his new boss pretty tough, especially her no dancing rule.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Cafe
programme.desc: In the park Bluey meets a new playmate Winnie, but when Bluey wants to invite her and her dad home for breakfast, she learns that adults take a little bit longer to make friends.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Obstacle Course
programme.desc: Mum sets up a backyard obstacle course just for fun, but Dad wants to race! Now the kids are determined to win by any means necessary.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Promises
programme.desc: Bluey keeps breaking her promises! But after seeing how much Bingo trusts Mum's word, Bluey learns the power of promises and why it's important not to break them.

programme.desc: When Mr Hammond tasks Andy with making sure the marine iguanas are clean for their inspection, Andy isn't sure what they need in order to do just that. Jetting off in his Safari Mobile, he heads to the Galapagos Islands in search of the answer.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Peas

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Being Quiet Badge

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Get Indoors Badge

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Camouflage Badge

programme.desc: Mojo and Bo need Ted's help to pull a wobbly duck statue up Swoppiton Hill. But does Ted know the best way? And will there be anything left of the duck when they get there?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - The Decider
programme.desc: The Heelers and Lucky's family get together to watch the big game, a fun family experiences that gets a little tense.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dirt
programme.desc: Judo desperately wants to play in the dirt with Bluey and Bingo, but she is not supposed to get herself dirty.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Cheerleading Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find Duggee's cheerleader pompoms, so he shows them his old moves. Time to practice: Duggee at the chess board, the Squirrels as a squad. There's a big match ahead...

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: It's a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mysterious Milkshake
programme.desc: More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Animals
programme.desc: The Squirrel club play games involving animals. The chickens do some rhythmic office work.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Leaning Tower of Pisa, Italy
programme.desc: The Go Jetters race to fix the Leaning Tower of Pisa, but has it really been glitched?

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Work
programme.desc: In a game of 'Work', Dad hires Bluey and Bingo at his drainpipe factory. But when Bluey takes charge, Dad finds his new boss pretty tough, especially her no dancing rule.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Cafe
programme.desc: In the park Bluey meets a new playmate Winnie, but when Bluey wants to invite her and her dad home for breakfast, she learns that adults take a little bit longer to make friends.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Obstacle Course
programme.desc: Mum sets up a backyard obstacle course just for fun, but Dad wants to race! Now the kids are determined to win by any means necessary.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Promises
programme.desc: Bluey keeps breaking her promises! But after seeing how much Bingo trusts Mum's word, Bluey learns the power of promises and why it's important not to break them.

programme.title: Andy's Safari Adventures S01 - Andy and The Marine Iguanas
programme.desc: When Mr Hammond tasks Andy with making sure the marine iguanas are clean for their inspection, Andy isn't sure what they need in order to do just that. Jetting off in his Safari Mobile, he heads to the Galapagos Islands in search of the answer.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Peas
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Fortress of Fun, where Kingsley and Queenie have fun looking for peas with the Playtimers in their Pea Party game.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Being Quiet Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels go on an adventure to find a famously shy creature called The Snard who doesn't like noise time to earn their Being Quiet badges!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Get Indoors Badge
programme.desc: A weather warning from Duggee's barometer leads the Squirrels to round up all the creatures they can find outside and pile into the clubhouse for an impromptu party.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Camouflage Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels meet a chameleon called Cosey and learn about how to blend into their surroundings, earning their Camouflage Badges in the process!

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Svalbard Global Seed Vault, Norway
programme.desc: Ubercorn and Glitch head to the Svalbard Global Seed Vault. But, just like when they were cadets together, the two of them get into trouble. Glitch accidentally crashes the Grimbler into the vault.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Mariana Trench: The Pacific Ocean

Glitch plans to beat him there by sending a Grimbot in his Grimsub, but it can't withstand the heavy pressure of the water. Lars and Xuli must work together to mount a rescue operation at the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: Thomas &amp; Friends S23 - The Other Big Engine

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Cake Decorate

programme.desc: Duggee arranges for the Squirrels to write to some pen pals, helping them to learn all about life in far away places, earning their Pen Pal badges and making some new friends in the process!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Being Quiet Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels go on an adventure to find a famously shy creature called The Snard who doesn't like noise time to earn their Being Quiet badges!

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Go Jet Academy: Sea Arch Escape
programme.desc: Xuli's flying race around the Academy inspires cadet Tala to fly the Grimbler. But she crashes into a fragile sea arch that could collapse right on top of her! The Go Jetters must race to save her.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Shopping Shenanigans, Istanbul, Turkey
programme.desc: In Istanbul's Grand Bazaar, Glitch wishes he could buy everything. Hearing about the wishes granted by the Hen's Eye Column in an underground water store, the Basilica Cistern, Glitch heads beneath the earth and brings the entire cistern close to collapse!

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Diesel Do Right
programme.desc: After being scolded for making a mistake, Diesel plays a trick on Rebecca to try and get the other engines in trouble.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Balloon Barnacles
programme.desc: Sarah's hat goes on an adventure without her, on top of a balloon.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Basking Shark

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Heavy

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S01 - It's time to look after Monty

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Space
programme.desc: Mackenzie, Jack and Rusty are playing as astronauts on a mission to Mars, but during their journey, Mackenzie keeps going missing and no one knows why, not even Mackenzie.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Smoochy Kiss
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want Dad all to themselves and will not let Mum have a smoochy kiss. They try to hide him all around the house, but Mum is desperate to spend a little romance time with her husband.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dirt
programme.desc: Judo desperately wants to play in the dirt with Bluey and Bingo, but she is not supposed to get herself dirty.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Diplomacy Badge
programme.desc: Betty and Sargent Ant just want perfection, but no one seems to be listening to their shouting! They need a lesson in diplomacy to learn how to speak in a more sensitive way.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Senses Badge
programme.desc: Roly has lost his best potato but Duggee finds it using his sense of smell. But what is a sense? Time for the Squirrels to learn about the five senses and earn their Senses Badge.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Spinning
programme.desc: The Teletubbies travel by Tubby Car to the Hidey Hup where they all spin around on the Tubby Spinny.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S06 - Umbrella
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'umbrella', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different types of umbrella - rainy, sunny and even dancing ones! Dee and a friend have frog umbrellas, and we even meet a Cinderella umbrella. The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S03 - Slippery Messy
programme.desc: It's the day of Mayor Oki's Ice Skate Skate-tacular. But there is too much ice, and it's stopping everyone from getting to the show! Messy must find a way to melt the ice and save the show.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - The Way of the Woods
programme.desc: A camping trip with Preston goes very wrong when he won't let them use Mojo's tops. But camping Preston's way soon starts a fire. It's Mojo and Bo to the rescue!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Exercise
programme.desc: Dad thinks he needs to do some exercise, but Bingo pretends to be Boss Bluey's new employee in the middle of Dad's backyard workout.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Cubby

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Good Choices
programme.desc: The Squirrels haven't been making good choices round the messy clubhouse. With Duggee's help, they start to get it right. But not before sending Roly's imagination into overdrive!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Waiting Badge
programme.desc: When they're accidentally shut in the shed, Duggee shows the Squirrels how to make the time pass with calm breathing and made-up games. The Squirrels cope so well. Does Duggee?

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mystery Seeds
programme.desc: When Duggee finds some seeds it's time for some gardening!

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Trampoline
programme.desc: When Dad has to stop having fun with the girls and go to work, Bluey and Bingo scramble to keep him playing games with them on the trampoline!

programme.title: Bluey S02 - The Quiet Game
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo are playing The Quiet Game and won't use words to tell Dad which toy to buy for Muffin. At his wits end, Dad recruits new store clerk Alfie to help interpret the girls miming.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Omelette
programme.desc: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dad's birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Born Yesterday
programme.desc: Dad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers food is delicious and steals Lucky's Dad's pie.

programme.title: Andy's Safari Adventures S01 - Andy and The Sand Grouse
programme.desc: Andy takes to his safari mobile and jets off to the Kalahari Desert in Africa. His mission; to find out how sand grouse chicks drink water.

programme.title: Godfather of Canton
programme.desc: A docker, Lin Si Hai, accidentally saves Commissioner Cheng who then offers him a position in the police force. Lin is smart and soon rises through the ranks through treachery and corruption, before becoming a gangster.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer (Li Ching), the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

programme.title: Portrait In Crystal
programme.desc: Tragic deaths in the underworld cause leader "Yama" (Teng Wei-hao) to suspect a portrait in crystal with mysterious powers. He sends Hen Pan (Chen Hung) and Pai Pan (Hung Hsin-nan) to interrogate its creator, martial artist Lung Fei (Pai Piao)...

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fiancé so as to drive away two women whom he does not like…

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: Masked Avengers
programme.desc: A mysterious new gang, the Masked Avengers, is slaughtering the martial world's greatest heroes. To stop them, three fearless fighters must track down the gang's hidden lair in Jingyang Town and put an end to their reign of terror.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: In the Yuan Dynasty, martial artists everywhere battle for the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Sabre, as only when these two powerful weapons combine can a secret be revealed to help one become the king of the martial arts world. As Zhang Wu Ji acquires the skills from "Nine Yang Scriptures" by chance, he is also embroiled in this lengthy battle.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness & innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: The Bully
programme.desc: For lovers of the Shaw's sumptuous production and martial arts expertise, this action adventure in the "Jackie Chan style" is a special treat. A persecuted waiter turns to a "drunken master" for help when a restaurant customer turns out to be a kung-fu harbinger of doom!

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to go to school and falls hopelessly in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After Shan Bo realizes her true identity, he proposes marriage to Ying Tai. However, they are kept apart as she is engaged to another man. Knowing Shan Bo died in despair, Ying Tai is in deep sorrow and kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: The Jade Faced Assassin
programme.desc: Two forbidden lovers, Zhang Zhen and Yue Nu, are killed by four villains and left behind their twin babies. Yue Nu's elder sister hopes to restore the clan's honour and separates the twins, arranging for them to be raised by competing clans. 18 years later, the twins meet and fight against each other, bringing chaos to the martial arts world.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: It's a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: Pursuit of a Killer
programme.desc: The charm of Pursuit Of A Killer lies in the long awaited reunion of Five Venoms duo, Lo Meng and Sun Chien; Lo Meng, who plays a Mainland Chinese criminal escapee to Hong Kong in search of a better life, and a cop (Sun Chien) who helps him adjust to Hong Kong life while tracking down his mysterious killer at the same time.

programme.title: Pursuit of a Killer
programme.desc: The charm of Pursuit Of A Killer lies in the long awaited reunion of Five Venoms duo, Lo Meng and Sun Chien; Lo Meng, who plays a Mainland Chinese criminal escapee to Hong Kong in search of a better life, and a cop (Sun Chien) who helps him adjust to Hong Kong life while tracking down his mysterious killer at the same time.

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: A long-awaited horror sequel after Enchanted Shadow, this is about three asylum inmates telling their stories. In story one, a husband and wife discover they should be careful what they wish for. A naked female ghost seeks revenge from her watery grave in story two, and a dead prostitute returns as a ghost in the last tale.

programme.title: Killer Constable
programme.desc: Kuei Chih-hung was famous for his modern day crime thrillers, his horror flicks, and even his comedies. But if the only kung-fu film he ever made was this one, he'd still be spoken of with respect by even the most ardent martial arts movie fan. Many consider this real life martial arts champion Chen Kuan-tai's best performance. As a deeply, even obsessively, dedicated Chief Court Constable, he illuminates the screen with fighting skill and emotional passion.

programme.title: Six Assassins
programme.desc: Lord Li Ming is a feudal tyrant who oppresses the people, and even the Emperor who is his brother, cannot stop his evil act. Righteous swordsman Mu poses as Li Ming's guard to plan for his assassination. He arrests six assassins who have tried to kill Li Ming, before making them his allies in a secret plot to kill him and end the tyranny.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples. Shaolin's Hung falls in love with Fang while escaping the hunt and the couple have a son before Hung is killed by the Priest. To avenge his father, Hung's son creates a new form of martial art combining his parents' kung fu styles.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Loh's looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet "Classic Beauty".

programme.title: 7-Man Army
programme.desc: This iconoclastic film retells the legend of seven Chinese patriots, who sacrificed their lives to defend against 20,000 Japanese soldiers and 50 tanks for 5 days, at a strategic key point of the Great Wall known as Pa Tou Lou Tzu.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywood's famous "Beach Party" movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: The Deadly Breaking Sword
programme.desc: Warrior Tuan Chang Qing meets courtesan Liu Yin Xi in a small town. Liu pleads Tuan to kill the underworld master Guo Tian Sheng, known as the "Killer Doctor", in order to avenge the death of her fiance. Tuan and gambling addict Xiao Dao breaks into Guo's household, triggering the battle of good against evil.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu's until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: The Kid with the Golden Arm
programme.desc: The government hires Yang to escort a cargo of gold to a famine stricken area. The vicious Chi Sha gang, with one of their best fighters, Golden Arm, announce their intention to hijack it by killing one of Yang's employees. As Yang gathers his own team of reputable fighters to protect his cargo, are they strong enough to hold off Golden Arm?

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: The Dragon Missile
programme.desc: Sima works for a corrupt lord Qin who is suffering from a deadly disease that only a special herb can cure. Qin sends him on an urgent mission to retrieve it, but the task is made more difficult when Sima has to fight off other martial artists who want to steal the cure away from him. He has to fight with his ultimate weapon, the Dragon Missile!

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: The Tigress Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Sam is being hunted as he discovers that the mayor and the chief of medical bureau are colluding with a drug dealer. He is saved by a fishermen family and works in their friend's grocery but the grocery owner is killed when the enemies track Sam down. Sam escapes to Shaolin to learn the cudgel style of kung fu in order to avenge his friends.

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: The Singing Killer
programme.desc: Chiang Yi is blackmailed into a jewellery heist by his former boss who threatens to expose his shady past. Complications arise when Chiang Yi discovers his first love working in the jewellery store.

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: The young Chen Chi-chin (Liu Yung) loses heavily to experienced gambler Hu Kuan-ten (Lo Lieh). His father loses at cards and dies of shock. Chen appeals to his uncle who summons seven fellow professional gamblers to carry out vengeance. Much more than a gambling film, this is a thrilling melting pot of martial arts stars, extortion, illicit love, poker-face vengeance, and all sorts of edge-of-your-seat gambling duels.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: Rendezvous With Death
programme.desc: Sun Chung had been recognized as an expert comedy and crime thriller director, but he was to gain even greater acclaim for his soulful, powerful, intelligent, and beautifully-made martial arts epics. This stands alongside The Deadly Breaking Sword and The Kung-fu Instructor as one of his very best.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor student Lin is engaged to the daughter of a rich man who despises him because of his family's declining status. Lin visits his fiancée before leaving for the Imperial examination, but finds a maid lying dead in blood. As Lin's bloody handprint is left on the site, he is accused of the murder. How can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: Murder Plot
programme.desc: Martial artist Shen Lang is in discussions with kung fu experts from the other six sects to plot the downfall of the traitorous Happy King when his fiancée suddenly disrupts them and Shen has to quickly bring her away. As they continue to pursue the Happy King, both Shen and his fiancée accidentally fall into a trap set up by the King.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The Condemned
programme.desc: Feng, a homeless man, is wrongly accused of robbery and subsequently arrested and imprisoned. The actual bandit bribes fellow inmate Yang, a pickpocket, to kill Feng. Aware of Feng's innocence, Yang resolves to help him escape from prison. However, their escape attempt goes awry, and both find themselves facing the grim reality of death row.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: My Rebellious Son
programme.desc: A corrupt official attempts to steal a priceless Buddha statue from a temple to please a group of Westerners. Luckily, Doctor Zhang and his son manage to defeat the Western boxers, the Japanese Kendo opponents and the Western longsword fighters with Chinese kung fu, thus saving the Buddha statue.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: Village of Tigers
programme.desc: The devilish residents of the Village of Tigers, led by Hu Jiao, plan to kill Lo Hong Shun, otherwise known as the heroic Sword of the Southern Sky. Hu Jiao sees a way to use the righteousness of the honorable Ba family to help him kill the hero Lo by turning them against him. Will good prevail over evil?

programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.desc: Nostalgia aims to represent Chinese traditional culture by revealing life in villages in the way of story-telling.

programme.title: TV Guide
programme.desc: Stay tuned to CCTV-4 as we introduce you to the various content and programming on the channel.

programme.title: Network News
programme.desc: Network News is a 30-minute programme focusing on news about China and the world.

programme.title: Dreamchaser
